name: Rising Beat
source:
Main character gets appointed as a manager of a new boys idol group 'Rising beat'. Will he aim at success or at someone's heart?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]

主角接下新出道男子偶像團體「Rising Beat」的經紀人。他會以事業成功為目標，還是以贏得某個人的心為目標？
